title: Origins: BuildCraft's Own
description:
This is an Origins Addon mod, current it add one Origin. The Giant! A realistic interpretation of a player scaled up to twice their normal size! I plan on adding at least one more Origin. 
This mod was made with substantial use of AI
body:
Origins: BuildCraft's Own

An Origin addon mod.

Currently it only adds one Origin, the Giant.

The Giant was designed to be a fairly realistic interpretation of what a scaled up player would be like.
The Giant comes with no special powers, or abilitys, it is just 4 blocks tall. And gets everything that comes with such a size, and belive me, there is a lot that comes with it.

I made this mod because I personally wanted it, and I plan on adding at least one more Origin to this mod later.

This mod is dependent on:
The Origins mod
The Pehkui mod
And Fabric API

This mod was made in part by AI.
